notes:
Top-line: regional power operator interested in an air-gapped Private deployment. Very conservative security posture; must run in fenced on-prem datacenter operated by their NOC. Prefer Redwood Private with KMS/HSM in customer control, FIPS profiles, and offline upgrade process.
- Prospect quote: "We cannot have egress under any circumstances — all telemetry must be stored internally and audit-log-forwarding controlled." 
- POC request: 6-week on-prem evaluation in their secure lab, must include load profile for 200 concurrent operator sessions and reranking job for AMI/SCADA logs.
- Cost sensitivity: medium — willing to pay for managed Private but procurement needs predictable ARR and clear TCO vs self-hosting.
- Security wants: SSO via SAML, SCIM user sync, audit trail retention 7 years, retention controls per regs, NERC CIP checklist completion.
- Ops: prefer scheduled upgrades during maintenance windows; require offline installer and signed images.
- Legal: Data residency in NA-only; no third-party telemetry, all logs to customer ELK stack.
- Internal champion: Dir. of OT Systems (Markus Reed). AE introduced via sector sales program.
- Quote: prioritize deterministic latency for operator chat (target p95 < 250ms for short prompts, 99th < 500ms under load).
use_case_summary: Replace ad-hoc operator automation scripts with an LLM-backed operator assistant for triage and runbook summarization; embeddings-based search across maintenance docs; reranking for alarm prioritization; offline evals for model acceptance.
